metadata.description: Production-quality plugins: install the base; add pqr-website, pqr-desktop, pqr-ui-system or pqr-process by kind of project (each brings the base).

plugins.name: production-quality-ready
plugins.description: The base: bootstrap-project writes a project's own work-cycle skills and gates.json; the audit owners write evidence files; apply_gates.py decides release-candidate, production-ready and sellable; ship releases.

plugins.name: pqr-website
plugins.description: For a public site: audit-website checks SEO, Core Web Vitals, cookies and links. Brings the base.

plugins.name: pqr-desktop
plugins.description: For a native desktop app on Windows: drive-app-window drives the window to prove a change. Brings the base.

plugins.name: pqr-ui-system
plugins.description: For a project that adopts the data-ui design system: ui-system holds the OKLCH tokens and the contract, and writes UI code. Brings the base.

plugins.name: pqr-process
plugins.description: Planning before code: spec, grill, map, slice, triage, diagnose, improve, handoff. Brings the base.
